subject: [RFC PATCH 15/57] mm/collapse: check what a candidate would freeze

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new function to check whether a candidate can be frozen in the mm/collapse module. The function walks through every slot covered by the candidate, under the table's ptl, and checks if all conditions are met for freezing. These conditions include that the folio is anonymous, not uffd-armed, and has no live mappings outside of the current span. The patch also adds a new trace event to track the scan result. If the candidate passes these checks, it can be frozen, otherwise the round only incurs the cost of the walk.
